prompt: In the Splice project {project}, crop the screen take to its left half so it fills the vertical frame, give it a purple gradient background frame with rounded corners, and make the cursor twice as big. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: cropped left half
checks.expr: any(c.get('crop') and c['crop']['x'] <= 0.05 and 0.4 <= c['crop']['w'] <= 0.6 for c in take_clips())

checks.name: framed
checks.expr: (effect('window', take_clips()[0]['id']) or effect('window') or {}).get('corner', 0) > 0 and (effect('window', take_clips()[0]['id']) or {}).get('color', '#6b5a7d') != '#6b5a7d'
